answer: I never drink coffee in the evening because it keeps me awake.
other_correct: Never do I drink coffee in the evening because it keeps me awake. (correct but formal/emphatic inversion, above B1; adds "do")
instruction_problem: Does not say to write the whole sentence again; the learner may not know to retype it. "The right place" is slightly vague: "because it never keeps me awake" is grammatical but illogical (sense changes), so only context rules it out.
